heroLede: Gypsum ceilings, fluted TV units and feature walls, painting, wallpaper, and waterproofing, finished with care for homes around Nairobi.
service1Desc: Flat and coffered ceilings, framed and finished cleanly, room by room.
service2Desc: Fluted panel units and feature walls that give a room a real focal point.
service3Desc: Interior and exterior painting, from prep and priming to the final coat.
service4Desc: Wallpaper supply and installation for feature walls or full rooms.
service5Desc: Waterproofing solutions for roofs, walls, and problem areas prone to leaks.
aboutText: Trained at The Kisumu National Polytechnic, I work hands-on as a house painter and decorator based in Nairobi: ceilings, feature walls, painting, wallpaper, and waterproofing. Every job is on-site work, start to finish, no middlemen. Follow along on Facebook and Instagram for the day to day.
